headline: Software Engineer & iOS Developer.
tagline: Want to know some basic things about me! Well I won't disappoint you. Let's take a look.
bio: A software engineer, tech lover, learner, and teacher. Who loves to discuss tech and software developments with sustainability. And yes, I love coffee and nature too! When I am not developing software, find me at the nearest traveling point or tourist place. Traveling is the second job that I do for myself. I pay myself in the currency of happiness!
